request.channel: reference[11]; entire aligned128B scope remains on its record channel
request.global_adapter: MC must reserve one descriptor on first beat and one beat credit per actual64B acceptance; compete with W using the same per-channel32/32 pools. Not wired by this unit.

CRC.deployment_table_integrity: separate whole-table SHA256 binding; inlineCRC is data integrity and not security authentication

ownership: full MC/task owner128 and task ticket32 retained until fetch response is accepted AND matching explicit release; taking raw descriptor does not free scope storage
source_lifetime: one monotonic31bit serial per accepted scope, no reuse within a session; exhaustion requires newer session initialization and actual external transport drain. Reset/rearm cannot assert that drain by itself.
cancel: stop new requests; preserve any already proffered request until actual acceptance; drain every accepted64B return; reject wrong/duplicate/old serial without modifying expected data or credits; never execute a partial descriptor
typed_decode: CRC success supplies raw128B to a separate provider-specific decoder. It must validate schema/version/capacity/topology/source key/object version/bounds before EXEC. CRC success alone is not typed admission.
not_done: actual shared MC global descriptor/beat adapter

partial_cancel_CLOSE.required_if: some but not all two beats issued, after all held requests accepted and no more issue is possible

fields.valid: held through real global registry acceptance
fields.ready: real no-more-issue registration, not an unbounded queue

partial_cancel_CLOSE.retirement: all accepted returns AND matching partial CLOSE accepted; zero-issued scopes allocate no global descriptor; normal full record closes implicitly
